name: planner-web-spectral-visualization
objective: Make Color-panel spillover understandable with honest schematic emission curves, optional user-entered detection-filter overlays, and persisted wavelength-aware channel ordering without claiming measured spectra or quantitative bleed-through.
invariants: Curves are normalized Gaussian schematics derived from KB emission peaks and one explicitly draft global FWHM; they are never labeled or used as measured spectra.
Detection filters are optional user inputs in center/bandwidth nanometers; the app never invents instrument filters.
Drag/drop and move controls change channel array order only; physical peak positions remain data-driven and immovable.
Existing five-state spectral resolution, review warning, peak-proximity flags, and free-text fallback remain intact.
All new web/src top-level symbols use spectral-specific names and must pass the single-file duplicate-symbol gate.
The built artifact remains self-contained and makes no fetch calls.
Claude's LLM/Describe files, questions.json, and advisor.json are read-only and out of scope.

tasks.title: Add the schematic curve-width KB contract
tasks.scope: Add overlapRules.schematicEmissionFwhmNm=50 with claude-drafted review status context, normalize it through loadSpectraKb with a backwards-compatible safe default, and expose it unchanged through shapeAppKb. Do not add per-fluorophore curve points or claim this is a measured width.
invariants: Existing proximity thresholds and every fluorophore peak remain byte-for-byte unchanged.
Missing or malformed schematic width never throws and falls back to 50 nm.
Runtime tests mutate the supplied width to prove consumers are data-driven.
tasks.verification: Run spectra.test.js and kbpack.test.js; assert real pack loads with zero issues, malformed widths degrade safely, and a non-default supplied width reaches returned overlapRules.

tasks.title: Build the pure spectral-view model
tasks.scope: Create a pure total module that samples normalized Gaussian schematic emission curves, validates optional center/bandwidth filter bands, derives a bounded wavelength domain, and returns a deterministic left-to-right visual model for known entries. Unknown/ambiguous/unavailable entries remain visible outside the curve model through the existing state rows.
invariants: Intensity is 1 at the emission peak and 0.5 at peak plus or minus FWHM/2 within numeric tolerance.
No NaN, Infinity, negative bandwidth, or out-of-range filter reaches SVG consumers.
Input arrays and channel objects are never mutated.
Series order is emission wavelength ascending with stable tie-breaking.
tasks.verification: Run spectralView.test.js with happy path, malformed input, tied peaks, near-edge filters, non-default KB FWHM, and no-known-entry cases.

tasks.title: Persist filters and channel ordering
tasks.scope: Extend normalized structured channels with optional filterCenterNm/filterBandwidthNm, add total immutable move/shift helpers, and add stable emission-order sorting driven by a caller-supplied resolver. Preserve backward compatibility for saved channels without filter fields.
invariants: Invalid or half-valid filter values normalize to null rather than fabricated defaults.
Unknown emission channels sort after known channels while preserving their relative order.
Bad ids, self-drops, empty arrays, and malformed callbacks are no-ops and never throw.
tasks.verification: Run panelAssembly.test.js with legacy shape, valid and invalid filters, drag-before-target, keyboard shifts, stable wavelength sort, duplicate peaks, and unresolved channels.

tasks.title: Propagate filters into study documents
tasks.scope: Carry normalized optional filter center/bandwidth values from structured channels into panelRows. Free-text fallback rows receive null filter values. Preserve all identity, state, peak, and control-gating behavior.
invariants: Structured channel order is preserved in panelRows.
Free-text fallback remains unchanged except for explicit null filter fields.
Unresolved spectra still keep their filter settings and honest state.
tasks.verification: Run studydoc.test.js; mutate stored filter values and require exact propagation while existing peak mutation and ambiguity tests remain green.

tasks.title: Show filters on bench cards
tasks.scope: Add a Detection filter (nm) column using center/bandwidth notation for complete filters and an explicit not-set value otherwise. Keep Markdown escaping/shape and all existing channel content intact.
invariants: Bench-card row order matches persisted channel order.
No invented default filter is printed.
Malformed panel rows remain total and readable.
tasks.verification: Run benchcard.test.js with complete, absent, malformed, and reordered filters; retain the runtime-KB peak mutation proof.

tasks.title: Render the accessible spectral SVG
tasks.scope: Render a responsive accessible SVG with wavelength axis, normalized curve paths, peak labels, translucent filter bands, curve/filter legend, empty state, and a persistent schematic-not-measured caption. Use DOM/SVG APIs without innerHTML interpolation or network dependencies; isolate CSS under spectral-view selectors.
invariants: Filter bands render behind curves and clip to the plotted wavelength domain.
Meaning is carried by labels and line styles as well as color.
The SVG has a concise accessible title/description and scales without horizontal page overflow.
tasks.verification: Run node syntax/import checks and visually inspect light/dark layouts at desktop and narrow widths using a panel with overlapping Deep Red dyes and at least two explicit filters.

tasks.title: Wire filters, drag/drop, and wavelength ordering into Color panel
tasks.scope: Use structured channels when present and free-text entries otherwise to refresh the spectral view. Add optional numeric filter center/bandwidth inputs, a drag handle/drop target, accessible move up/down buttons, and Order by emission wavelength. Persist every change through panel.channels and refresh without moving physical peak positions.
invariants: Typing into a filter never destroys target, conjugation, fluorophore, or channel id fields.
Sort is offered only for structured channels and known emissions; unresolved rows remain stable at the end.
Drag/drop and keyboard controls share the same immutable reorder helpers.
The existing free-text resolver, flags, seeding, advice panel, and review banner remain visible and correct.
tasks.verification: Exercise add/seed/edit/filter/drag/move/sort/remove flows in the built app; reload after each persisted operation; verify known-left-to-right ordering and stable unresolved tail.

tasks.title: Run end-to-end build and adversarial verification
tasks.scope: Run affected tests, full JavaScript and non-reader Python suites, deterministic single-file build twice, duplicate-symbol gate, no-fetch check, visual interaction verification, ownership/dashboard updates, and independent adversarial review. Fix every blocking defect before completion.
invariants: BioIO and metadata-reader integration remain parked and excluded exactly as authorized.
A repaired failed task is recorded resolved, never relabeled done.
No commit, push, PR, merge, or Claude-worktree edit without separate user authorization.
tasks.verification: All web tests, non-reader Python tests, build tests, two identical builds, source collision scan, visual desktop/mobile checks, and an independent high-reasoning verifier pass.

tasks.title: Add hover, focus, and independent on/off state
tasks.scope: Make every curve and detection-filter band mouse- and keyboard-interactive. Hover/focus must name and emphasize the element, dim peers, expose a plain-language details card, and support independent on/off state through both the plot and accessible legend buttons. Preserve state across spectrum refreshes within one Color-panel visit.
invariants: Every interactive SVG data element has an accessible name, role, pressed state, and Enter/Space toggle.
Every element that can be turned off retains a visible legend control that can turn it back on.
Curve and filter visibility states are independent and are not persisted into assay scientific data.
Renderer refreshes after filter edits do not reset visibility state.
tasks.verification: Drive mouse hover, focus, plot click, legend click, Enter, and Space in the served built artifact. Toggle a curve and its filter independently, edit a filter to force refresh, and prove the retained states and accurate accessible text.

tasks.title: Clarify chart text and print filter values
tasks.scope: Increase axis and data-label contrast, add haloed fluorophore peak labels, print each center/bandwidth value directly on its filter band, and style hover/focus/legend states in both themes without changing scientific values.
invariants: Filter text uses the exact user-entered center/bandwidth values and includes nm units.
Line style and text continue to carry identity without relying on color alone.
All new selectors remain scoped under spectral-view classes and do not alter Claude's LLM UI.
tasks.verification: Inspect dark and light built-artifact screenshots, computed text colors, direct SYTO9 identification, overlapping filter labels, and narrow-width layout.

tasks.title: Verify shipped interaction artifact
tasks.scope: Run the full web/build gates, deterministic single-file build twice, no-fetch and duplicate-symbol checks, live built-artifact interaction traces, dashboard/handover updates, and a frontier adversarial verifier. Fix every blocking defect before handover.
invariants: Only the built single-file artifact is accepted as browser evidence.
BioIO and metadata-reader integrations remain parked.
No commit or push occurs without separate user authorization.
tasks.verification: Full web suite, 24 build tests, two byte-identical builds, built-artifact mouse/keyboard/theme checks, and independent high-reasoning adversarial review.
